finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pptx-actions.ts::pptx export aborts entirely when a single image fetch fails, unlike the pdf path which degrades gracefully
evidence: The supplied sources confirm every link in the chain: `exportSlidesPptxAndDownload` in packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pptx-actions.ts passes an un-guarded `fetchImage` that calls `docsImageFetcher`, which throws on any non-ok response (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/export-utils.ts, `Image fetch failed: ...`); `exportPptx` awaits `opts.fetchImage(src)` in the Step-2 pre-scan loop of packages/slides/src/export/pptx/index.ts with no try/catch, so the rejection propagates out and `runExport` in slides-export-button.tsx surfaces "Export failed". The PDF sibling does degrade: `resolveDeckImages` in packages/slides/src/export/pdf.ts wraps each `fetcher(src)` in try/catch and substitutes `BLANK_PNG`, so the described inconsistency is real. I rate it minor rather than major because it only triggers for a deleted/forbidden image and fails loudly with a message rather than producing a corrupt file — but the all-or-nothing abort for one bad image is a genuine, avoidable UX regression relative to the PDF path.
